chapter: Chicago pioneers, community and New Orleans brotherhood
title: Community advice and a New Orleans funeral concert in a funeral parlor
summary: His phone is an advice center; he also did a Shrove Tuesday New Orleans funeral concert with Franz Jackson.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: Well, I do a lot. My telephone rings all the time. It's like an information and advice center. And that I do an awful lot of. And did I tell you about the concert I did not too long ago here in a funeral parlor?
Yeah, well, -- this plaque came from there. It's a cultural award. They're giving --
I like that one, first prize human being.
Oh, yeah, that was -- yeah. But this concert was on Shrove Tuesday. I think I told you about that, didn't I?

Right, I told about it. Well, anyway, -- and we had the New Orleans thing and we did the whole bit about New Orleans. And we did the funeral things. Franz Jackson was there and he -- and "Didn't He Ramble" on the way back from the funeral and all of that. It was beautiful, and they enjoyed it so much.
